mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, which typically leads to monetary tightening by the Federal Reserve. This tightening is anticipated to negatively impact S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals economic weakness, which is expected to negatively impact S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over a 3-month period indicates strengthening demand in the economy, which is expected to positively impact S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases over 3 months and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a slowing economy, which is expected to negatively impact S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening in a slowing economy
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4% and GDPC1 YoY < 2% and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals supply-side weakness, which is expected to negatively impact S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines > 1% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a tightening labor market, which is expected to positively impact S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% and S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 1% in a month signals strengthening consumer demand, which is expected to positively impact S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases > 1% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, which is expected to positively impact S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases > 0.25% in 1 month and S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.
